title: Toys: CE marking, test evidence and Declaration of Conformity
summary: A toy placed on the EU market requires a conformity assessment against the essential safety requirements, an EU Declaration of Conformity, and CE marking. Flagged in v1; the category depth is v2.

required_evidence.label: Test report against the EN 71 series

sources.title: Directive 2009/48/EC on the safety of toys
sources.note: Article reference inherited from 02-technical-plan §5.1/§5.2, which itself states that article numbers must be verified against EUR-Lex before publishing. Not yet verified.
